title: Input classification carries each input's related companies
rule: Every classified input carries its related objects (entity ids, each with its basis) and its unresolved identifiers, read only from the identifiers the channel gives and from the author when the author is a company, never from the text or the URL; a ticker resolves on its publication day, an unresolved identifier is kept (never a refusal), and related objects never change the tag.
quote: 好，补进分类模块，仿真跑通先
note: D11 turned related companies into related objects of four kinds.

title: Config holds only the choices a person makes
rule: Config holds only the choices a person makes: model settings (one per extraction category and one per library model call) and the search size; facts come from classification, mechanisms (when work runs, retries, rounds, due triggers) belong to code, and what is researched and tracked belongs to the universe.
note: Log records 'By: Alex, in the Config discussion' without his words. PRD 03 lists no collision (D190) or idea setting though the configurations carry both.

title: Config has no budget or concurrency limits
rule: Config has no limits section: no budget per policy, no total budget and no concurrency; where limits live, if anywhere, is not decided.
quote: 我觉得3 不是一个重点可以完全干掉
note: D181/D183 keep worker counts as run arguments, not Config, citing D3. D46 added the search size N to Config.

title: Dispatch is by tag only, never by company
rule: An item's related companies (objects) play no part in dispatch.
quote: 不看公司，因为这个pipeline 应该不管公司的，就是按照tag的种类来分发
note: Tag filtering removed by D18, text/structured branch by D25. POC code (dispatch.route) does read object_identifiers and universe.watches, standing in for upstream scope.

title: Time is the material's own time and the run's day
rule: Time is the material's own time: what the system sees follows each material's publication time (published_at, cut to the New York day by D9); no rule reads the computer's clock, retrieved_at is for audit only, and classification writes no admitted_on.
quote: 是的，用材料的时间，不要陷入之前的问题
note: The run day T, its daily advance and day markers were dropped by D12; replay left the design (D7).

title: The research universe is its own module
rule: The list of what is researched (500+ US equities, crypto assets, commodities and other asset classes) is a module of its own with its own versions, managed apart from Config; each entry is an entity id from the reference data with its asset class, and a run records the universe version it used.
quote: 公司主题名单可以单独管理，我们有500多个us euqity, crypto commodity etc. 所以模块上这个需要写进某个地方
note: D10: the universe is handed upstream as the supply scope, not read by a fetch step; D59: its themes also go to extraction.

title: No input store; replay is a test database, not a design concern
rule: The system keeps no copy of the materials it reads (they stay in the team's own database), only a processing record of which material, by id and version, was processed, how and with what result, besides the views library; testing the past is streaming a test database through the same logic.
quote: 不会消失，我们自己有自己的database and pipeline 不会消失; 那和系统设计无关啊，只是一个test database

title: Classification's lookup tables: one data file, results are tags
rule: Classification reads four lookup tables (datasets, form codes per filing system, publication series, authors) kept in one JSON data file that production and tests both read; a changed table is a new classification version, loading checks that every value is valid, and the code↔company table is not a classification table.
quote: 你要做一份json数据文件或是yaml 好查找maintain的统一数据结构
note: Design only; the POC's corpus assembly supplies categories (pipeline-plan).

title: A day is cut in New York time; only the day counts
rule: Each material belongs to the New York calendar day it was published on; the hour and minute play no part in any rule (an SEC filing's day follows D34), and a copy merged into its original gives the original the earliest day among them.
quote: 好按照纽约时间切，不要再产生什么时间戳漂移的问题，那几分钟几秒其实根本没差，不要自己给自己制造麻烦
note: D31: inside one day items are ordered by arrival number; D34 replaced the EDGAR acceptance day.

title: The system starts at a stream of classified items
rule: The system's boundary is a stream: an upstream pipeline keeps feeding items that already carry their classification and the system validates the contract, dispatches, processes and builds its store; nothing in the system pulls sources, the same upstream id and version is not processed twice, and testing streams a test database in publication-day order through the same path.
quote: 现在就是assume 又一个pipeline 会不断的feed 打好classification tag 的信息进来，这个系统应该怎么处理
conflicts: D364: the coverage-start reading reads the company's latest report directly from the source store, once, outside the stream (PRD 04 records the exception)
note: Its day markers and current day were dropped by D12.

title: Related objects and the theme library
rule: The universe holds four kinds of object (company, crypto, commodity, theme), the theme library being its theme part; rates, FX and indices are data that themes track; classification's related objects may be any of the four kinds, written by kind, and a theme comes only from the object upstream fed the item for or from an upload's declaration, never from the text.
quote: 我觉得主题是必要的。你可能得跨政治经济战争地缘政治通胀等各种宏观因素做这个主题库
note: How a company reaches a theme moved to dependencies (D38) and the theme block (D191, D195).

title: No current-day clock in the system
rule: The system keeps no current day and no day markers: each item carries its own New York publication day, processing an item reads that item and the state left by earlier items (never the wall clock), and when no item arrives the stream does nothing; date-driven work is pull mode's, which gets its 'now' as an input.
quote: 没有新的thesis 或日期为什么要硬推进
home: AGENTS.md §3 (Never order by the wall clock); docs/prd/02-classification.md time rule 2; 08-pull-mode.md

title: The system is driven by information, not by the calendar
rule: The system moves forward only when an item arrives: its facts move the theses, ladders and evidence that depend on them, there is no daily step in the stream, and a day without items changes nothing; date- or schedule-triggered work exists only in pull mode.
quote: 不需要按部就班的推日期，有相关的信息抽取出现，自然会影响整个系统抽取的thesis 向前
conflicts: D63: re-judging is a once-a-day round after the day's items (the day from the replay, in production from pull mode), against 'There is no daily step anywhere in the system'
note: D14 scoped it to stream mode.

title: Two modes, designed apart: stream and pull
rule: The system has two modes designed apart: stream mode, where arriving items move theses and the calendar is never read, and pull mode, the only place where time triggers work; 'pull' names only this system-initiated checking, and the feed from upstream is upstream supply.
quote: 这是stream的相反模式，也就是pull mode (agent 主动查找）这个我们后面设计，但是我希望你分的很清楚这两种模式
note: Pull mode today only closes due questions (D356); its proactive evidence search and fetching settlement figures are not built.

title: Macro, political and economic material in the classification
rule: The publication series table is checked before the author type, is open to any publisher, keyed by (publisher, series) and yields only T8, T10 or T11 (T10 only for an official publisher); T11 is macro policy and statistics whoever publishes them, author entries carry validity dates by term of office, international organizations are official, and 'not an input' covers only indicators the system can compute from inputs it already has.
quote: 你持续思考反思直到solid. 不要乱加戏，但是千万注重细节
home: docs/prd/02-classification.md §Decision order, §The four lookup tables, rules 4–6, §Excluded material
note: Rules reasoned by Claude at Alex's instruction, frozen with his approval (D19, D37). Reasoned, not simulated.

title: A human review pool for what the tables do not know
rule: What the tables do not know is not guessed but goes to a human review pool (unregistered codes and datasets and undetermined author types refuse the item; unregistered series and unresolved identifiers are processed and recorded; contract violations), only real gaps enter (a resolvable identifier merely outside the universe is not one), one entry per gap with its count and examples, and only the intake is designed, not the output.
quote: 把他认为是一个exception handling pool for human review; 复核池不要画虚线出来，再module 写明白这个部分先不设计output
note: Later sources: proposed themes and repeated failures (D31, D41); unsure matches no longer go there (D41, D45).

title: Receive is merged into dispatch
rule: There is no separate receive step: dispatch is the single entry, and one decision tree asks in order whether the item meets the contract (no → refused, to the review pool), whether the same id and version was processed before (yes → skipped) and what its classification outcome is, so every item reaches exactly one destination.
quote: 接受和分发什么区别？你在给自己加戏吗？
conflicts: D364: the coverage-start reading enters the latest report's figures once, before the first item, without passing dispatch (PRD 04 states the exception)
note: Tree reduced to three questions by D18 and D25.

title: One switch: the universe decides what is processed
rule: The universe is the one switch for what is processed: it states for each object the tags it tracks (a default per kind; each theme its own list of at least one valid tag); the supply scope is objects × tracked tags, kept by whoever writes the stream and not checked by dispatch; every item that arrives is processed, Config holds no processed tags, and a new object or tracked tag is a new universe version whose past items upstream feeds.
quote: 那你就这样改 … 一定要严谨
note: The POC has no upstream: src/hivemind/dispatch.py route drops items whose objects or category the universe does not track.

title: Freeze v1: everything up to classification
rule: The research universe, the Input classification contract, Config, dispatch and the human review pool are frozen (v1; frozen again with extraction by D37); a later change needs a new decision, with the classification simulation run again or the boundary materials reasoned through again.
quote: 我们当前为止到classification 的模块和定义都可以freeze了吗，做最后一次review
home: AGENTS.md §Authority and scope; status lines of PRDs 01–04 and 09
note: AGENTS cites D19/D37 for the freeze rule; the sealed copy docs/archive/2026-10-16-v1 is still in the tree.

title: A PRD per module, in Markdown, viewable from the design page
rule: docs/prd/ holds one PRD per module plus an index, frozen modules with full PRDs and undesigned ones listing what is decided and open; the design page opens each module's PRD; precedence is Alex, then DECISIONS, then the PRDs and the page, and a change to the page or a new decision updates the PRD in the same change and rebuilds the bundle.
quote: 你现在应该针对每个模块写prd，并且归档好，并且在FE的地方点进去模块能再打开预览PRD，PRD就用 .md来写就好，FE解析呈现好看就好
note: Amended 2026-10-18 (Alex): every detail page opens its PRD. The extraction standard is an HTML page beside PRD 05 (D242).

title: Any change refreshes everything, by one command
quote: 嗯如果有改动需要全部刷一遍
note: docs/refresh.py no longer exists; docs/check.py is the check-only script (D22).

title: Refreshing is a reasoning pass; the script only checks
rule: After any change Claude refreshes everything by reasoning, module by module in a fixed order (universe → classification → Config → dispatch → extraction → thesis library → closing at the due day → pull mode → review pool → system overview), checking each against DECISIONS and fixing and listing every inconsistency in the same change; docs/check.py is only the last mechanical step and its pass does not mean the refresh is done.
quote: 你跑refresh.py有什么鸟用，这个是需要reason的需要llm跑

title: Tables without XBRL tags are read by the model
quote: 可以交给模型
note: Its point (untagged tables read by the model, no parsing code path) lives on in D25/D27: no code-processing module, every item goes whole to the model.

title: Financial reports are not streamed; pull mode reads them when a thesis needs them
quote: 我同意，我们不应该再stream 财报了，这个没有意义。应该是在我们还没设计的pull mode 里面采用。
note: Its thesis-first point (no number warehouse) stands via D28, AGENTS §11 and PRD 00 principle 1; pull-mode fetching of report numbers is not built.

title: One extraction module, read by category from a senior hedge fund analyst's view
rule: There is one extraction module: every item that belongs to a category goes to it with its category and is read by its category with one template prompt whose fixed persona is a senior hedge fund analyst reading to form and test views; the program, not the prompt, owns the output shape and checks every number and quote against the source, and Config records each category's model and prompt version.

note: The production request is the frozen v74i (role, categories, review, day-start open questions; D264, D274); PRD 05's five-block template is the design text.

title: The views database is the system's core
rule: The system builds, updates and closes a views library, its core: views are the model's judgments and evidence is objective (who said what, where); every view, piece of evidence and change carries its source (upstream id and version, category, publication time, location, quote), code refuses a source it cannot find or a quote not in the document, both directions can be looked up, and closed views and old versions are kept for history.
quote: 其实整个system做的事情就是建构，更新，删除这个data structure
note: Its object → driver → view structure was replaced by D38.

title: Extraction reads the whole item by category, then matches it against the drivers
rule: Every item, whatever its form, goes whole to the model with its category's template.
quote: 就是他妈的整个文档丢给llm去解读就好了，不用再分什么有的没得
note: D351: what is fed is the cleaned page, not an article cut. Its driver-matching steps 2–5 moved to the library (D33) and were replaced (D39).

title: Financial reports stream again
rule: Earnings releases (T1), periodic reports (T2) and earnings calls (T4) are in the stream (company default T1–T10, T12–T15) and read like every other item into views and evidence; D24's thesis-first point stands: no number warehouse.
quote: 我觉得新的财报应该还是可以推进来，但是观点就变成抽取新的 + 验证当前的

title: A final verdict before any view is closed
quote: 确实让模型完整看一遍再关掉是稳妥的，这边可以多画一个环节block就是来做final verdict
note: PRD 07 now holds closing at the due day; Config's final_verdict setting stays in the frozen configurations, read by no step (D356).

title: Conflicting sources and the consensus
rule: Evidence has four tiers (happened; said by the party itself; third-party view; rumour) and views are not decided by vote: only the 'happened' tier can meet a condition (since D38/D45: settle which rung holds) while the others only strengthen or weaken, and sources are counted by original source (twenty outlets relaying one scoop are one).
quote: as a hedge fund analyst, how would you deal with these conflicting views?
note: Claude's answer to Alex's question; D45 keeps tiers and counting by original source as decided. Add-only conditions, conflict trigger and consensus by code were dropped (D38, D51).

title: Order, one writer, and the link between the levels
rule: Dispatch numbers each item in arrival order, never by the wall clock, and each view has one writer (its object's queue) that receives other items' evidence as messages carrying their numbers; an item reads only the state left by items with a smaller number, the result must equal one-at-a-time processing, only items produce evidence (views pass notices), and a failed item retries from the step it reached, repeated failures going to the review pool.
quote: 反正是stream, 理论上时间是以前走到近期，所以应该要time sorted
home: AGENTS.md §3 (Never order by the wall clock); docs/prd/06-views.md §Ordering; 04-dispatch.md
note: 'Time sorted' is Alex's; queues and retries were Claude's (D55 flags one such addition). Premises, late-item and leaving rules replaced; extraction reads the day-start snapshot (D251, D264).

title: Table data comes one release at a time; XBRL is not pushed again
rule: A filing's XBRL numbers are not pushed as items of their own (the filing, read whole, carries them); table data is pushed one release per item, whole; and nothing gets a price-specific rule: the pipeline keeps its shape and whatever the universe streams goes whole to the model.
quote: 如果是财报直接进来，那就不用重复XBRL了啊，这不是废话吗; keep the shape of the pipeline as is, don't 自己加戏

title: Extraction only reads; matching and writing belong to the views database
rule: Extraction reads each item whole with its category's template and hands candidate views and evidence, each with its source, to the views library; it never changes the library, and matching, deciding and writing (with Config's matching setting) belong to the library.
quote: 你确保抽取环节就只是抽取thesis 理解不，我们探讨的都只是不同classification 该怎么抽取或是走什么数据
note: D149 keeps this boundary for group association; since D264 extraction files statements under open questions, the writer still writes.

title: An SEC filing is dated by the day SEC makes it public
rule: An SEC filing's publication day is the day SEC makes it public, its statutory filing date (accepted before 17:30 ET, that day; after, the next business day), carried by filing_date; the hour plays no part in any other rule.
quote: ok 可以
note: simulate_classification.py does not model this rule (known limit).

title: Extraction v1 is final
quote: 抽取你最后review 一次可以定稿了吗
note: Its rules (one prompt per category T1–T15, output shape owned by code) live in PRD 05; wording frozen at v74i (D274), so PRD 05's 'category prompt wording needs validation' is stale.

title: One word per concept in the input and extraction modules
rule: The glossary in docs/prd/00-system.md names one word per concept and the words not to use; docs/check.py scans the in-scope page data and PRDs and fails on any avoided word, with a control sentence the check must catch.
quote: 你和codex 要一起完全对齐用字用词，这个非常重要，不然我们的PRD就是瞎几把写的，你深度的抠

title: Freeze v1 of the input side and extraction
rule: The research universe, classification, Config, dispatch, extraction and the human review pool are frozen as v1 in their 2026-10-18 text; what each PRD lists as open stays open, and a change to a frozen module needs a new decision.
quote: 好你把写完的freeze了在html 上……我们要继续move on

note: AGENTS cites D19/D37 for the freeze rule; D58 renewed the freeze for all modules but pull mode.

title: The views database rebuilt: a view is a question with a five-rung ladder and a due date
rule: A view is one question with a fixed ladder (each rung observable, rungs non-overlapping and covering every outcome; asset views strongly bullish to strongly bearish for the business, theme views named by outcome) and a due date when the debate settles (usually 6–12 months; a number's on its publication day), never rewritten. Evidence is stored once with its source and tier, counted by original source, its push written on the link by each judgement, and views relate by one-direction dependencies and succession chains.
quote: 这个 hypo 更像是一个 thesis with a state; 一条观点一定是有一个明确的 ladder 和到期日，这样才构成一个观点呀
conflicts: D186: asset-thesis rungs state the business outcome against guidance with the favourable end registered per thesis (decided, not built); PRD 06 still fixes strongly bullish → strongly bearish
D208/D253: seed driver questions carry a dependency on the root they feed, while D38/PRD 06 read B→A as 'B reads A's conclusion' (PRD 10 §3: arrows reversed, open for Alex)
note: Gone: two positions (D46), answer sources and 'ends answered' (D54, D57). Judges read evidence in view (D198); the rung is a forecast against a reference (D260).

title: Writing into the views database: match by where a candidate belongs, then one round of re-judging
rule: Writing into the library is one round per item in dispatch order, code accepting only listed ids and the succession rules; records are append-only (matching, re-judging, succession, closing, merging and labels each add a record with the dispatch number) so any past day can be replayed, and evidence that links to no view is not stored (the processing record notes it).
quote: 已经存在的观点就 merge，日期遵照之前已经存在的期限
note: Key matching, list details and storage became proposals (D45), replaced by D46/D155; re-judging moved to once a day (D63); repeats/replacements keep both pieces (D202, D204).

title: The matching judge: a general model first, every match recorded, humans label, a small model later
rule: Every match writes a matching record (the item, the candidates as handed over, the list in the order shown, who decided, the request and raw answer with the Config version, the decision with reasons and code's checks, what was written); people label records (D46: those code refused and a random few), a smaller model trained on labels may later decide where confident, and labelling never blocks the stream or writes the library.

conflicts: D169: Jev is the default matcher, while PRD 06 'Matching labels' still says 'Initially a general-purpose model judges step 4'
note: The generative model is kept for the collision judge (D190); human labels and the smaller model are not built.

title: What the rebuilt views database changes outside it
rule: Each library model call has its own Config setting with its temperature, and every model call records the Config version; macro and geopolitics reach a company through dependencies (universe rule 8); the review pool receives themes proposed for matters with no theme in the universe and failed items, not unsure matches, and a candidate about a company outside the universe is not built, only noted.
quote: you need to add it to the current PRD, you need to add it to the current system design … put everything into context

note: Verdict/pull drafts it kept were replaced (D54, D356); duplicate-check setting dropped (D45); Config also holds collision and baseline settings (D190, D364).

title: Extraction hands over evidence and candidate views as two things; evidence is matched to what its view already holds
rule: One extraction read hands over two things, each with its source: evidence, linked to the questions shown in the request or to a candidate view of the same item (one home, D207), and candidate views for important matters none of the shown questions covers, carrying the evidence that raised them; evidence linked to nothing is not extracted, the same thing said in several places of one item is one piece with several sources, and a yes-or-no question has two rungs.

title: Alex decides Claude's views proposals one by one
rule: A view has one state judged by the model from evidence (decisive information included; no answer source) on a ladder of checkable, non-overlapping rungs covering every outcome; a number view names its year (this year is the item's, a company's fiscal year; at most this year and next open); matching searches the whole library for the top N (Config, 10 to start) and the model decides same view (a part goes into its open view), next period or new view, a bundle of things moving apart not being opened. The model picks a new view's dependencies (code refuses loops), a view has at most one next period keeping its ladder's direction, views relate only through conclusions and are judged dependencies first, once per round, judgements cite evidence ids that code looks up, past judgements are read from records, the timeline only grows forward, and extraction writes a candidate in full.

title: Claude's open items settled: one re-judging rule, dependencies chosen in the matching call, no consensus
rule: A view is re-judged when what it reads changed (new or replaced evidence, a repeat alone not counting, or a dependency whose judgement says its conclusion changed), and every judgement says whether its conclusion changed (rung moved or a key fact or number changed), code checking only that a rung move and a first judgement say changed. A new view's dependencies are chosen in the matching call from the views shown (search results, prompt part 5, views new in the same item), code checking they were shown and form no loop; consensus is not part of the design and third-party views stay evidence of their tier.

title: A view's state is frozen at its due date; pull mode runs at the end of the day
rule: A view has one state and no answer apart from it: at the due date the state is frozen where it stands, that rung is the view's conclusion and the view closes; what settles the debate arrives as evidence like any other, and a view depending on a closed view reads its frozen state. Pull mode runs at the end of the day (or on a cron interval) and freezing the views due that day is part of that run; nothing waits for the day's items, and stream mode handles no timing.
